observations: Photo shows multiple motorcycle engines/engine assemblies on a workshop floor.
No clear brand/model markings are readable on the visible parts.
No close-up of identification plates/serial numbers.
No clear view of the specific engine the seller intends to sell (photo shows several units).
No evidence of testing (no running video, no diagnostic screen, no stated test results visible).

claims.claim: We also deals on all kinds of car spare parts
claims.evidence: Photo appears to show motorcycle engines/parts, not clearly car spare parts.
No shipping documents, labels, or country-of-origin markings visible in the photo.
No running video or test report shown; photo only shows engines/parts.
No audio/video of engine running; no inspection report visible.
No odometer/ECU mileage reading or service record visible.
No seals/fastener condition close-up to confirm it was never opened.

risks.risk: Wrong item / not the exact engine being offered (photo shows multiple engines/assemblies).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the exact unit being sold with a unique identifier (serial/engine number) and the same unit shown from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown used engine/assembly with possible missing parts and no confirmed condition.

risks.risk: Condition not actually tested (could be defective, incomplete, or damaged).
risks.proof: Request a short video of the engine starting and idling (or a compression test/diagnostic printout).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed working (worst case: not working / needs overhaul).

risks.risk: Mileage claim cannot be verified remotely.
risks.proof: Request a photo of the odometer/ECU mileage screen or service record showing mileage.
risks.if_unproven: Price as average/unknown mileage (worst case for value).

risks.risk: “Never opened” cannot be verified (could have been repaired before).
risks.proof: Request close-ups of gasket/seal areas and fasteners (head cover, crankcase covers) showing no tampering.

risks.risk: No knock claim cannot be verified without audio while running.
risks.proof: Request an audio video during idle and light revs, plus a mechanic’s brief inspection note.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential internal wear (worst case: knock/engine noise possible).

risks.risk: Identity/compatibility risk: engine may not match the buyer’s bike/car application.
risks.proof: Request the exact make/model/year of the donor vehicle/bike and the engine code/part number from a readable label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic/uncertain compatibility (worst case: buyer may need extra parts).

proof_requests: Send close-up photos of the exact engine’s identification plate/engine number (readable) and the same unit clearly marked in the frame.
Send a short video of the engine starting and idling (with audio) or provide compression test/diagnostic results.
Provide photos of any mileage/ECU reading or service record that supports “low mileage.”
Provide close-ups of seals/gaskets/fasteners to support “never opened.”
State the exact make/model/year the engine fits (and the engine code/part number).
response.reason: The photo shows multiple motorcycle engines/assemblies but the exact item, brand/model, and test status are not verifiable from the image. Without readable identification and proof of working condition, a safe worst-case price cannot be determined.
